# IELTS Ai Pro

> IELTS Ai Pro (https://www.ieltsai.pro) is a web-based IELTS preparation platform. Learners can practise Reading, Listening, Writing, and Speaking; receive AI-assisted practice feedback; calculate an estimated overall band; and track their progress after signing in.

Key facts:
- AI feedback and band scores are practice estimates, not official IELTS results.
- Writing feedback follows Task Achievement or Task Response, Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource, and Grammatical Range and Accuracy.
- Speaking feedback covers Fluency and Coherence, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy, and Pronunciation when supporting evidence is available.
- IELTS Ai Pro is independent and is not affiliated with IELTS, IDP, the British Council, or Cambridge University Press & Assessment.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://www.ieltsai.pro/): Platform overview, product features, pricing, FAQ, and sign-up path.
- [IELTS Band Score Calculator](https://www.ieltsai.pro/ielts-band-score-calculator): Overall-band calculator using IELTS rounding rules plus Listening and Reading raw-score conversions.
- [Blog](https://www.ieltsai.pro/blog): IELTS preparation articles and study guidance.
- [About](https://www.ieltsai.pro/about): Platform mission and story.
- [Contact](https://www.ieltsai.pro/contact): Support at mail@ieltsai.pro.
